root_causes.description: frontend pods experiencing excessive restarts (z>1000) due to definition changes, confirmed by K8s events showing 'Container frontend definition changed, will be restarted (count=2)'. This is the most anomalous signal across all metrics and services in the incident window.

evidence.query_or_id: K8s events: Created: Created container frontend (count=3); Started: Started container frontend (count=3); Killing: Container frontend definition changed, will be restarted (count=2)
evidence.observed_value: Container frontend definition changed, will be restarted (count=2) during incident window
evidence.expected_baseline: No container definition change events expected in normal operation

root_causes.description: payment service shows extreme memory usage anomaly (z=+9.25, window=1.397e+08) significantly above baseline (1.392e+08±5.7e+04), indicating potential memory pressure that could contribute to instability across dependent services.
ad service shows elevated memory usage anomaly (z=+4.18, window=4.762e+08) above baseline (4.751e+08±2.5e+05), suggesting memory pressure that may impact service stability.

remediation_steps: Roll back frontend deployment or pause ongoing deployment causing definition changes; investigate CI/CD pipeline for changes that triggered frontend pod restarts
Monitor payment and ad memory usage; consider increasing memory limits or optimizing resource consumption if anomalies persist
